sources.processing: Major road geometry extracted; degree-two chains merged, Douglas-Peucker simplification approx 50 m for base roads, 13 m for connections. Point coordinates rounded to six decimal places. No raster tiles or screenshots.

connectionMethod.engine: Local Dijkstra on cached OSM road graph
connectionMethod.oneway: yes/1/-1, motorway default and roundabout directions handled; access=no/private and motor_vehicle=no excluded
connectionMethod.label: Illustrative coverage connections along real roads. Not navigation directions or live route/timing estimates.
connectionMethod.origin: Bombinhas OSM town reference point; not exact company street address.
connectionMethod.snapping: Routes follow nearest connected road nodes; markers stay at town reference points or terminal polygon centroids. Original point to graph offsets 32–139 m.
